Specify OnDemandPrice to set the amount equal to the On-Demand price, or specify an amount in USD.[EbsConfiguration] - Specifies additional Amazon EBS storage volumes attached to EC2 instances using an inline JSON structure.[AutoScalingPolicy] - Specifies an automatic scaling policy for the instance group using an inline JSON structure
